## Beverlywood Neighborhood — 90035
- Beverlywood is a residential neighborhood in West Los Angeles
- ZIP code: 90035 (also includes parts of Pico-Robertson)
- Boundaries: Olympic Blvd (north), Pico Blvd (south), Robertson Blvd (east), Beverwil Dr (west)
- Jewish community: one of the largest Orthodox and Modern Orthodox communities in the US
- Walkability: walkable to Pico Blvd, Beverly Hills adjacent
- School districts: LAUSD, Beverly Hills USD nearby
- Average luxury home rent: $25,000–$50,000/month
- Beverly Hills adjacent — 5 min drive to Rodeo Drive
